title.narrative: HIV/TB - Malawi (01-Jul-2024-30-Jun-2027)

description.narrative: Malawi, TB/HIV, World Vision Malawi (WVI)This program has the following goals: To contribute towards ending AIDS as a public health threat in Malawi by 2030. Reduce TB incidence to 102/100000 by 2027. Reduce TB mortality to 18/100,000 pop by 2027. The objectives of this program are: To contribute towards ending AIDS as a public health threat in Malawi by 2030. Reduce TB incidence from 132 in 2021 to 102/100000 by 2027. Reduce TB mortality from 15 in 2021 to 18/100,000 pop by 2027. Building resilient community systems for effectively respondingt to the TB and HIV epidemic
